title: SCP Semantic Capsule
description: JSON Schema for a Semantic Capsule conforming to UBVM-SPEC-001 v1.0. A capsule encodes declared AI agent intent, containment class, permitted primitives, and cryptographic provenance.

scp_version.description: SCP protocol version. Must be '1.0' for this schema version.

capsule_id.description: Globally unique capsule identifier. UUID v4 format (RFC 4122).

node_scope.description: Node Scope Identifier. Must match the executing node's NSI, or cross_node_auth must be present.

declared.description: Human-readable statement of what this capsule intends to do. Part of the provenance hash.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity classification of the capsule's declared intent.

containment_class.description: Containment class. Determines which primitives this capsule may invoke. Enforced at runtime by UBVM Stage 4.

id.description: Operator identifier. Opaque to the runtime; recorded in the audit log.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of this capsule's canonical representation (spec §9.1). Lowercase hex, 64 characters.

parent_capsule_id.description: UUID of the parent capsule, or null if this is a root capsule.

primitives.description: List of primitive names this capsule may invoke. All must be registered in the node's dispatch table.

payload.description: Capsule-specific data. Contents are defined by the primitive handlers invoked. May be empty {}.

expiry.description: Optional. If present, the capsule is rejected after this timestamp (spec Stage 6).

metadata.description: Optional. Operator-defined metadata. Not validated by the runtime. Not included in the provenance hash computation.

target_node_scope.description: NSI of the target node authorised to execute this capsule.

authorised_by.description: NSI of the node that issued this cross-node authorisation.

auth_token.description: Opaque authorisation token issued by the authorising node. Format is implementation-defined (spec §11.2).

cross_node_auth.description: Required when capsule is executed on a node whose NSI does not match node_scope (spec §11).
